verified_claims.shared_miss: The report does not claim absence of shared errors; it describes no newly established definitive major shared harm and preserves uncertainty about generalizability strengthening.
verified_claims.roles: Same-family AI with role/context separation, no human or cross-family validation; possible style-based unblinding and instruction-only file restrictions are disclosed.
verified_claims.packet_scope: Science Results/tables/figures and full BoE minutes excluded from scored packets; MOEL release does not constitute full legal text; source collection scope and supplementary expansion are distinguished.
verified_claims.user_procedure: The procedure is presented with an explicit non-guarantee and unresolved-comparison example. Its stop rule is prospective operational guidance, not demonstrated perfect enforcement.

unresolved_concerns: Material relevance is disputed for every KO frozen omission and three of four EN omissions; neither initial nor later AI classification is gold.
Two judges can agree within an output while classifying identical baseline text differently across outputs; the KO R09 case demonstrates this.
No completed common-union adjudication of previously-unlisted findings is established by the reviewed report artifacts. Raw supported labels alone do not meet the preregistered category.
Semantic harm depends on interpretation: observable explicitness/attribution loss, unsupported strengthening, reasonable contextual inference and actual reader harm remain distinct.
Supplementary evidence supports qualitative science comparison direction and exact category boundaries but does not establish direct low-versus-moderate significance or a treatment effect.
Same-family shared blind spots, small accessible sample, incomplete timing metadata and absent independent historical freeze authentication remain limitations.
